name: Tatsuhime Rabu
source:
Mishima's ex. 28 years old.

Women and alcohol are the twin loves of her life. She used to freeload at Mishima's place.

Her ex showed her a whole world she had known nothing about, and Rabu loved her for it. However, when Mishima was about to start work at St. Leanne's, she took the opportunity to break up with her. It's unclear where she's gone since then.

She speaks inarticulately even while sober, but nevertheless always keeps a cool head on her shoulders. In her own overly sensitive kind of way.

[Translated from [url=https://x.com/fenrirvier/status/1995028265145438421]the author's Twitter.[/url]]
